newsitem.title: UK: Nat Power links with Power Pacific in China.
newsitem.headline: Nat Power links with Power Pacific in China.

text.p: Britain's National Power Plc said on Wednesday it agreed to team up with Power Pacific Company to develop and invest in power projects in China.
The two companies will set up National Power Pacific Company (NPPC) for investments, likely to be between $200 and $300 million, in power plants up to 200 megaWatts over the next two to three years.

National Power said it had already secured $50 million of investments in three co-generation projects in China while Power Pacific has completed five projects in the country, placing about $80 million of equity.
Power Pacific, based in Hong Kong, will lead development of the projects while National Power will manage on behalf of NPPC.

"Together, we intend to develop a material portfolio of power projects and to become one of the most significant forces in the Chinese market," said Max Herbert, National Power's director of international business development.
